source_and_ledger_identity.note: Original-source content checks validate identity only; edited assistant content is validated against ledger after and candidate tokenization.

source_attribution_and_license_metadata.note: Per-row provenance is source attribution, not a legal license assertion. Missing redundant per-row license/dataset fields is reported as unknown metadata, not proof that a row is unusable for local inference.

limitations: Lexical overlap does not prove or rule out semantic dependence.
Passing token/mask checks does not approve training or establish semantic quality.
